summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Hindi Editorial Newsroom CMS. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed including stats, list/filter, create, publish invalid-state 400, delete + 404, full AI rewrite->publish flow (verified original headline/content preserved, rewritten output is Devanagari, pending decreases by 1 and rewritten increases by 1). Frontend: dashboard loads, stats cards render, all 4 status filter tabs work, add-news modal creates a Pending item, 'Approve for Rewrite' button appears only on Pending_Review cards, clicking it shows loading state and after AI completes opens the ComparisonModal with original vs Devanagari rewritten content, modal publish button transitions item to Published (stats updated), theme toggle switches dark class on <html>. Verified end-to-end integration between UI and backend via external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/news returns 200 instead of the more conventional 201 Created (minor REST style, not a bug).
seed_data uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers for future FastAPI versions.
handleRewrite in NewsDashboard.jsx catches error but toast.error() references e?.response?.data?.detail which is fine; consider surfacing HTTP status too for debuggability.
'news-search-input' is not exposed via NEWS constants (uses raw literal). Minor consistency nit.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed_data() on startup seeds 5 pending + 1 rewritten + 1 published = 7 items. Verified counts via GET /api/stats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (uses pytest-xdist parallel workers, runs in ~10s including a real Gemini rewrite call). All TEST_ prefixed items are cleaned up in each test's finally block. If Gemini quota/latency issues appear, the test_rewrite_and_publish_flow has 120s timeout.
